messages:
sam: Heads up — customer reported a weird double-charge when a streaming session resumed and retried a tool call after a truncation/tombstone. Anyone seen this pattern?

mika: Yep, I can repro. Sequence: client opens stream -> toolcall invoked (side-effectful) -> connection drops mid-suffix -> client reconnects and we replay suffix bytes -> billing shows both original provisional and replayed confirmed.

raj: Hmm, is the toolcall idempotency token missing on the replay path? I thought we used session_id to dedupe.

mika: We do for toolcall requests at the API layer, but the replay path rehydrates from the resume snapshot and doesn't attach the original toolcall-id header. So ledger treats replayed suffix like a fresh consumption.

emily: Dashboard note: I saw a small spike in "provisional->confirmed delta" around 03:22 UTC for that customer. It matched reconnect spikes.

sam: Logged it as edge-case: resume path loses toolcall idempotency tag. Possible fixes: attach original toolcall token to resume events, or mark replayed suffix as provisional until confirmation from tool. Thoughts?

billing-bot: Created billing ticket BLG-9142 for investigation and provisional reversal walkthrough.

raj: Attaching token sounds safest long-term. Quick mitigation: when replaying, check for tombstone markers and avoid incrementing the confirmed ledger until toolcall ack idempotency is validated.

mika: Prototype patch: add resume_metadata.toolcall_id to snapshot and propagate on replay. Minimal diff: \n```\n- snapshot.replay().emit(suffix)\n+ snapshot.replay().with_header('x-toolcall-id', snapshot.toolcall_id).emit(suffix)\n```\n
sam: Nice. Also update the console: surface "resume-replayed" flag on per-route token breakdown so ops can filter these events while we roll out.

emily: I'll add an alert rule to flag >2% replayed-confirm delta per-customer in the next 24h.

raj: One more gotcha: some older clients don't send session origin info, so they won't have the toolcall id in snapshots. We should fallback to last-confirmed-ack dedupe for those.

mika: Agreed. I'll open a PR with snapshot propagation + fallback dedupe and include unit tests for truncated EOF -> reconnect -> replay scenario.

sam: Thanks — can you add a small dashboard tile in the PR screenshot showing the spike? that'll help support to correlate.

billing-bot: BLG-9142 updated: investigator assigned to mika, priority P2.

emily: tagging @support to prep a CB for the affected customer in case reversals are needed. :thumbsup:

sam: OK closing loop here. Plan: patch + tests (mika), console flag + dashboard (sam/emily), billing ticket follow-up (billing-bot). Revisit in ephemeral standup tomorrow.
